issues: Covers and spend per head dropped - good weather midweek and a weak weekend; the promotional game drew existing customers only and lost money.
Food cost well above target and under investigation to establish whether a supplier shortfall caused it.
Labour above target on the back of the lower sales, with little room left to cut.
Review average slipping with too few new reviews coming in; trade heavily reliant on a core of regulars.
Service dips during unexpected rushes outside the usual busy periods.
Kitchen porters not cleaning the sink area properly overnight after suppliers left debris in it.
A new competitor is opening nearby with a two-for-one offer, following another large opening that is already fully booked.
Kitchen capacity a concern for the expected September uplift; no hiring until sales rise consistently.
